HALF_PART_TYPE, CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE1 HALF_PART_CODE, CASE WHEN CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE1 IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(CEIL(#{queryPlan} * SIDEWALL_LENGTH / 1000), 0) ELSE 0 END PLAN, '1' UNIT, R.ID, R.MACHINE_ID MACHINE_ID, R.DAY_PLAN_QTY CLASS1_PLAN, R.NIGHT_PLAN_QTY CLASS2_PLAN, null CLASS3_PLAN, null CLASS4_PLAN, R.IS_RELEASE PUBLISH_STATUS, null STEEL_STRIP_CODE2 FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI LEFT JOIN T_CD90_SCHEDULE_RESULT R ON R.CLOTH_CODE = CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE1 AND R.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND R.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate} WHERE CI.EMBRYO_CODE = #{embryoCode} AND CI.EMBRYO_VERSION = #{bomDataVersion} AND CI.DEL_FLAG = '0' UNION ALL /** 2#胎体布 **/ SELECT '10' HALF_PART_TYPE, CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE2 HALF_PART_CODE, CASE WHEN CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE2 IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(CEIL(#{queryPlan} * SIDEWALL_LENGTH / 1000), 0) ELSE 0 END PLAN, '1' UNIT, R.ID, R.MACHINE_ID MACHINE_ID, R.DAY_PLAN_QTY CLASS1_PLAN, R.NIGHT_PLAN_QTY CLASS2_PLAN, null CLASS3_PLAN, null CLASS4_PLAN, R.IS_RELEASE PUBLISH_STATUS, null STEEL_STRIP_CODE2 FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI LEFT JOIN T_CD90_SCHEDULE_RESULT R ON R.CLOTH_CODE = CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE2 AND R.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND R.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate} WHERE CI.EMBRYO_CODE = #{embryoCode} AND CI.EMBRYO_VERSION = #{bomDataVersion} AND CI.DEL_FLAG = '0' UNION ALL /** 3#胎体布 **/ SELECT '11' HALF_PART_TYPE, CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE3 HALF_PART_CODE, CASE WHEN CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE3 IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(CEIL(#{queryPlan} * SIDEWALL_LENGTH / 1000), 0) ELSE 0 END PLAN, '1' UNIT, R.ID, R.MACHINE_ID MACHINE_ID, R.DAY_PLAN_QTY CLASS1_PLAN, R.NIGHT_PLAN_QTY CLASS2_PLAN, null CLASS3_PLAN, null CLASS4_PLAN, R.IS_RELEASE PUBLISH_STATUS, null STEEL_STRIP_CODE2 FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI LEFT JOIN T_CD90_SCHEDULE_RESULT R ON R.CLOTH_CODE = CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE3 AND R.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND R.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate} WHERE CI.EMBRYO_CODE = #{embryoCode} AND CI.EMBRYO_VERSION = #{bomDataVersion} AND CI.DEL_FLAG = '0' UNION ALL /** 帘线大卷（米） **/ SELECT '12' HALF_PART_TYPE, CI.CORD_SPEC HALF_PART_CODE, CASE WHEN CI.CORD_SPEC IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(CEIL(#{queryPlan} * SIDEWALL_LENGTH / 1000 * (NVL(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT1, 0) + NVL(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT2, 0) + NVL(CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT3, 0)) / 1000 / NVL(P2.PARAM_VALUE, '1.45')), 0) ELSE 0 END PLAN, '1' UNIT, R.ID, R.MACHINE_ID MACHINE_ID, R.DAY_PLAN_QTY CLASS1_PLAN, R.NIGHT_PLAN_QTY CLASS2_PLAN, null CLASS3_PLAN, null CLASS4_PLAN, R.IS_RELEASE PUBLISH_STATUS, null STEEL_STRIP_CODE2 FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI LEFT JOIN T_XWYY_PARAMS P2 ON P2.PARAM_CODE = 'BREADTH' AND P2.DEL_FLAG = '0' LEFT JOIN T_XWYY_SCHEDULE_RESULT R ON R.BIG_ROLL_CODE = CI.CORD_SPEC AND R.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND R.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate} WHERE CI.EMBRYO_CODE = #{embryoCode} AND CI.EMBRYO_VERSION = #{bomDataVersion} AND CI.DEL_FLAG = '0'

SELECT ID, MACHINE_NAME, '1' HALF_PART_TYPE FROM T_TM_MACHINE_INFO WHERE del_flag = '0' UNION SELECT ID, MACHINE_NAME, '2' HALF_PART_TYPE FROM T_TC_MACHINE_INFO WHERE del_flag = '0' UNION SELECT ID, MACHINE_NAME, '3' HALF_PART_TYPE FROM T_NC_MACHINE_INFO WHERE del_flag = '0' UNION SELECT ID, MACHINE_NAME, '4' HALF_PART_TYPE FROM T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO WHERE del_flag = '0' UNION SELECT ID, MACHINE_NAME, '5' HALF_PART_TYPE FROM T_GSQ_MACHINE_INFO WHERE del_flag = '0' UNION SELECT ID, MACHINE_NAME, '6' HALF_PART_TYPE FROM T_CD15_MACHINE_INFO WHERE del_flag = '0' UNION SELECT ID, MACHINE_NAME, '9' HALF_PART_TYPE FROM T_CD90_MACHINE_INFO WHERE del_flag = '0' UNION SELECT ID, MACHINE_NAME, '12' HALF_PART_TYPE FROM T_XWYY_MACHINE_INFO WHERE del_flag = '0'

select machine_name, id as machine_id from T_TM_MACHINE_INFO T_TC_MACHINE_INFO T_NC_MACHINE_INFO T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO T_GSQ_MACHINE_INFO T_CD15_MACHINE_INFO T_CD15_MACHINE_INFO T_CD90_MACHINE_INFO T_CD90_MACHINE_INFO T_CD90_MACHINE_INFO T_XWYY_MACHINE_INFO where del_flag = 0 and status = 0
